Existing-conditions map of the Ama-Sellers study area on an aerial base, with a legend. The Mississippi River is at the top, the Union Pacific and Burlington Northern Santa Fe rail lines cross the area, and Hwy 18 is at the west end. Symbols mark existing culverts (open, blocked, and unknown size), existing bridges, the existing Ama-Sellers pump station, parcel boundaries, SCP-owned parcels, and existing subsurface culverts. Labelled streets include Anna St, Kennedy St, Pats Court and Alice St. Sellers Canal is labelled south of the rail lines.
Logo only (TBS). Not content; candidate for removal.

Improvement groups map for Ama-Sellers on the existing-conditions base. IG-1 primary channel improvements (orange) run along the Union Pacific line and south along Anna St. IG-2 secondary channel improvements (yellow) are three channels running north from the Union Pacific line between Anna St and Kennedy St. IG-3 pump station (green) sits at Kennedy St. IG-4 pump station outfall creation (blue) runs south under the BNSF line and then southwest toward the marsh.

IG-1 detail (primary channel improvements). Callouts: upgrade existing culvert (two locations, one under the Union Pacific line near Anna St and one under the BNSF line), new culvert required at the west end of the Union Pacific line, widen existing channel along the Union Pacific line, and replace existing culvert with box culvert at Kennedy St. Cost table: channel widening $941,000 (25-year) and $1,366,200 (100-year); culvert improvements $216,000 (25-year) and $247,000 (100-year).

IG-2 detail (secondary channel improvements). Three channels are labelled: West Channel and Culvert Improvement, Middle Channel and Culvert Improvement, and East Channel and Culvert Improvement, all running north from the Union Pacific line. Cost table (25-year / 100-year): West $125,100 / $179,800; Middle $174,000 / $287,000; East $125,000 / $179,700. These three items total $424,100 / $646,500, which does not match the Group 2 row of $416,000 / $635,000 in the summary table (fig 9).

IG-3 detail (pump station). A new pump station is marked in green on the north side of the Union Pacific line at Kennedy St, with required jack-and-bore culverts under the Union Pacific line for the pump station. The hatched strip running north-south is not labelled in the figure. Cost table: pump station $3,814,200 (25-year) and $8,962,200 (100-year).
Logo, north arrow and scale bar only (TBS; scale 0 to 230 ft). Not content; candidate for removal.

IG-4 detail (pump station outfall). Callouts: required jack-and-bore culverts where the outfall crosses under the Union Pacific and BNSF lines, and outfall channel creation (blue) running south from the pump station and then southwest. Cost table: outfall channel creation $1,730,300 (25-year) and $2,290,000 (100-year). IG-1 (orange) and IG-2 (yellow) channels are shown for context.

Summary map of all four improvement groups on the existing-conditions base, with a summary table. Totals: 1 Primary channel widening $1,157,000 (25-year) / $1,613,200 (100-year); 2 Secondary channel improvements $416,000 / $635,000; 3 Pump station $3,814,200 / $8,962,200; 4 Outfall channel creation $1,730,300 / $2,290,000; overall total $7,117,500 / $13,500,400. The Group 2 row does not equal the sum of its three channel items in fig 5 ($424,100 / $646,500).
